---
title: Header pinning
---

## Overview

Website pages keep their header — the navbar and, on narrow screens,
the sidebar toggle bar — fixed to the top of the viewport. To leave
more room for reading, the header slides out of view as you scroll
down and reappears as soon as you scroll back up.

This matches Quarto 1's behavior and needs no configuration.

## Keeping the header always visible

To keep the navbar on screen at all times, pin it:

```yaml
website:
  title: "My Site"
  navbar:
    pinned: true
    left:
      - href: index.qmd
        text: Home
```

With `pinned: true` the header stays fixed at the top and never slides
away.

Sidebars accept the same option; pinning either the navbar or the
sidebar keeps the whole header in place:

```yaml
website:
  sidebar:
    pinned: true
    contents:
      - index.qmd
```

## Interaction with menus

While a navigation menu is open — the navbar's collapsed hamburger
menu, or the sidebar drawer on narrow screens — the header stays put
regardless of scrolling, so the open menu can't slide off screen. It
resumes normal behavior when the menu closes.
